subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule technical deep-dive demo
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:05 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule technical deep-dive demo

Thanks again for your time today, Jordan — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Summary (from today's discovery):
- Goal: evaluate Redwood to accelerate inference for Acme's analytics pipeline while reducing per-token cost and meeting 99th percentile latency targets.
- Success metric: demo that shows integrated latency < 150ms p95 on sample workload, cost estimate, and integration checklist.
- Constraints: some services will remain on-prem; security/compliance review is required.

Proposed next step: technical deep-dive demo with our solutions engineer (Vivek) to walk through integration pattern, perf benchmarks, and security controls.

Proposed times (all Pacific):
- Wed 11/11: 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 11/12: 13:00–14:00 PT
- Fri 11/13: 09:00–10:00 PT

Can you confirm which slot works and who will join from your side (engineering, infra/security, procurement if applicable)? I attached a short one-pager about Redwood to help share internally.

Attachments: redwood-product-one-pager.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: schedule technical deep-dive demo

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap, that matches our notes. Wed 11/11 10:00 PT works best for our team.

Attendees from Acme:
- Jordan Lee (Head of Data) — myself
- Emily Park (DevOps lead) — handles infra/network
- Miguel Torres (SRE contractor) — will help validate latency tests

One quick ask: can you include any pre-reqs we should prepare (sample data, firewall allowlist, approximate runtime requirements)? Also confirm whether this will be Zoom or Google Meet.

Jordan
Jordan Lee | Head of Data, Acme Analytics
jordan.lee@acme-analytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Emily Park <emily.park@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:40 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: schedule technical deep-dive demo

Perfect — Wed 11/11 at 10:00 PT is reserved.

Pre-reqs (short):
- If you can provide a small sample payload typical of your inference requests (anonymized), that will help us run realistic perf checks.
- Please allowlist zoom.us domains (we'll send Zoom link) and allow TCP/UDP for typical meeting connections.
- If you have a staging dataset or a representative prompt set, send that ahead of time.

I'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link shortly. Vivek (cc'd) will lead the demo and cover integration and perf tuning. I've also attached a brief demo agenda.

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-analytics.com>, Emily Park <emily.park@acme-analytics.com>, Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@sre-contractors.com>

Hi all — calendar invite sent. Details below and in the attached calendar file. Please accept if the slot works.

When: Wed, Nov 11, 2026 10:00–11:00 PT
Where: Zoom — https://zoom.us/j/987654321?pwd=Demo123
Agenda:
- 10:00–10:10: Introductions and goals (Marissa, Jordan)
- 10:10–10:40: Architecture & integration patterns (Vivek)
- 10:40–10:55: Performance demo and Q&A (Vivek & Miguel)
- 10:55–11:00: Next steps and success criteria (Marissa)

Attachments: calendar-invite.ics (calendar), redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF)

Notes: Miguel — are you internal to Acme or an external contractor? If external, we'll keep any NDA/procurement items separate; otherwise we'll include you in follow-ups.

Link to deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2026-089

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
